traits.note: Goffinet and Shaw, Bryophyte Biology (2009), p. 128 (as extracted 2026-10-15, card bryo-p128-1): in the Hypnanae the sporophytes arise on side branches (pleurocarpy), and the shoots branch freely and usually creep, so they grow as mats; p. 88 (card bryo-p88-1): a creeping main axis with pinnate branches gives a feathery outline.
